name: Tanvir Ahmed
comment: Local market e 3,200 taka chacchilo, ekhane pre-order e matro 2,250 takay peyechi! Exactly 13 diner moddhe parcel chole ashche. Sound quality top notch!
commentEn: Local stores asked 3,200 BDT, got it here via pre-order for just 2,250 BDT! Arrived in 13 days. Pure sound quality!

name: Nafis Fuad
comment: Initially 40% advance dite ektu voy lagchilo, but WhatsApp e regularly status update disilo (China packaging -> Dhaka Airport). Shotti authentic 49g mouse pelam, highly recommended!
commentEn: Was slightly hesitant about the 40% advance, but the WhatsApp team kept sending milestone updates. Got the authentic 49g mouse, 100% recommended!

name: Sayeed Hasan
comment: Display brightness ar Bluetooth calling darun. Packed condition asol brand sealed chilo. Shobcheye bhalo lagche hidden customs charge chilo na.
commentEn: Super vibrant AMOLED display and clear BT calling. Authentic sealed box. Best part: zero extra customs fees at delivery.

name: Arif Chowdhury
comment: Ryzen 7 7700X e use korchi, load temperature 72C er upore jay e na. Local e stock pawa jachilo na, TechBridge er through te pre-order kore easily peyechi.
commentEn: Using it on Ryzen 7 7700X, temps never exceed 72C under heavy load. Out of stock locally, TechBridge imported it seamlessly.

name: Mahmudul Hasan
comment: Laptop + iPhone eksathe fast charge hocche. Heavy weight genuine charger, heating issue nai.
commentEn: Powers both MacBook and iPhone simultaneously. Genuine Baseus product without heating issues.
